goal: Prevent useful development-time hosted-model advice from silently contaminating permanent Alice/Fable training lineage when its service terms do not clearly permit that use.
procedure: Refresh applicable service terms before admitting hosted-model output into permanent training. If commercial/competitive model-development use is restricted or unclear, mark the output advisory-only, remove it from active training paths, add an executable manifest gate, and reproduce equivalent curriculum through an approved public, owner-authored, deterministic, self-hosted-permissive, or later native-FBM path.
constraints: do not erase the lesson merely because the raw output is not training-authorized
do not turn legal/terms hygiene into a teacher tournament
training code must fail closed when origin/rights manifest is missing or prohibited
future FBM training requires its own clean origin manifest
decision_criteria: each curriculum has a content hash and origin
hosted output is not assumed trainable merely because it is high quality
authority: This trace records process only. It does not make legal determinations or authorize a source whose terms do not permit training.
validation: The active N0 ranker path now requires an explicit training-authorized curriculum manifest and rejects OpenAI service output/unknown hosted output by default. The earlier Sol-authored training seed was removed from the active training tree and remains historical/advisory only.
failure_or_lesson: A builder model must learn provenance and rights as part of data formation. High-quality synthetic material is not automatically valid training material. Fail closed once per source, then keep building.
notes: Supersedes any implication in the previous N0 curriculum trace that ChatGPT/Sol-authored rows were training-authorized for permanent Alice/Fable weights.
